l-m-m2-b0s5-07.s.s1.r.b: Nyaya 3 apo vese vanoratidza chinhu chimwe chete yakarurama.
l-m-m2-b0s5-07.s.s1.o.d: (4) Kutora hafu yenyaya seyekuti A anohwina
l-m-m2-b0s5-07.s.s1.r.d: Pfungwa yokuti A anohwina muhafu yenyaya dzine anohwina yakarurama.
l-m-m2-b0s5-07.s.s1.explain: Nyaya dzine anohwina ndi 9−3=6. A anohwina muhafu yadzo, nzira 3, saka mukana ndi 3/9=1/3.
l-m-m2-b0s5-07.s.s2.model.0: Mu (3) inoti 9+3=12, asi nyaya dzine anohwina ndihwo huwandu hwose kubvisa dzekuenzana, saka 9−3=6. Kana yagadziriswa, ndi 3/9=1/3.
l-m-m2-b0s5-07.s.s2.model.1: Nyaya dzisiri dzekuenzana ndihwo huwandu hwose 9 kubvisa 3 dzekuenzana, saka (3) yakanganisa. Hafu ye 6 ndi nzira 3, saka mukana ndi 1/3.

l-m-m2-b05-30.s.s1.prompt: Nzvimbo yesquare ye hypotenuse nekureba kwe hypotenuse zvi chii?

l-m-m2-b05-30.s.s2.model.0: Kuwedzera nzvimbo dzemasquare maviri madiki kunopa 9+16=25, saka nzvimbo ye hypotenuse i25 uye hypotenuse i5.
l-m-m2-b05-30.s.s2.model.1: a²+b²=c² inoreva kuti huwandu hwenzvimbo hwakaenzana, saka hypotenuse ndiyo square root ye25, iyo i5.
